label: Bible Study
prompt: Therefore I take pleasure in infirmities, in reproaches, in necessities, in persecutions, in distresses for Christ's sake: for when I am _____, then am I strong.
verse: Therefore I take pleasure in infirmities, in reproaches, in necessities, in persecutions, in distresses for Christ's sake: for when I am weak, then am I strong.
note: Paul learned this when his thorn in the flesh wouldn't go away — weakness became the strong place.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And the Lord make you to increase and _____ in love one toward another, and toward all men, even as we do toward you:
verse: And the Lord make you to increase and abound in love one toward another, and toward all men, even as we do toward you:
note: Paul prays the Thessalonians' love will increase and abound — toward each other and everyone else.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Moreover the king made a great throne of _____, and overlaid it with the best gold.
verse: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with the best gold.
note: Solomon's great throne was ivory overlaid with the best gold — six steps up, with twelve lions standing on them.

label: Deep Water
prompt: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down, yea, we _____, when we remembered Zion.
verse: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down, yea, we wept, when we remembered Zion.
note: The exiles' lament in Babylon — Jerusalem's songs were too painful to sing in a foreign land.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: For ye shall not go out with haste, nor go by flight: for the LORD will go before you; and the God of Israel will be your _____.
verse: For ye shall not go out with haste, nor go by flight: for the LORD will go before you; and the God of Israel will be your rereward.
note: No need to flee in panic: the LORD goes before you, and the God of Israel is your 'rereward' — your rear guard. Covered both ways.
